settings.label: Wordmark
settings.info: Set in the heading face in the header, the menu and the footer. Leave empty to use the site name.

settings.label: Logo
settings.info: Shown in place of the wordmark in the header when set.

settings.label: Reveal on scroll
settings.info: Cards and photos fade up, headings rise in word by word and photos drift as the page scrolls.

settings.label: Texture
settings.info: A flat dot grid in a corner of the inset hero and the booking band's link layout.

settings.label: Address
settings.info: One line per line of the address.

settings.label: Directions
settings.info: One line, for example: An hour north of Kelowna on Highway 97.

settings.label: Open
settings.info: May to October, or Year round.

settings.label: Booking

options.label: A link to the booking app

settings.info: The theme takes no bookings: the button links to your booking app, and the booking band can embed its page.

settings.label: Booking link
settings.info: Your booking app's page. Every Check availability button links here.

settings.label: Booking embed address
settings.info: The address of your booking app's embeddable page. The booking band shows it in a frame. Script widgets cannot be embedded.

settings.label: Map image
settings.info: A static map, linked to the map link.
